# Contract fixtures

Copies of the event schemas from synthwerk-contracts. The integration tests check
every event pulse writes against them.

- Source: `VelimirMueller/synthwerk-contracts`, tag `go/v0.1.0` (commit `6e760f5`).
- Files: `events/envelope.schema.json`, `events/pulse/target.status_changed.v1.schema.json`.
- Update: copy both files again when `go.mod` moves to a new contracts version.
